title: Brand system quick guide / October 2018
slide_intent: Identify the guide and its edition so readers can place its instructions in time.
strategic_value: The black field and white Uber wordmark can make even the introduction an encounter with the core identity.
demonstration: A large two-line title and edition date occupy the upper left of a black panel; the Uber wordmark anchors its lower left.
practical_value: Use the cover to distinguish this October 2018 quick guide from later or more comprehensive standards.

content_islands.name: Title and edition
content_islands.spec: Place the white title above the lighter date at the upper left of the black panel.

content_islands.name: Uber signature
content_islands.spec: Place the white wordmark near the lower left; preserve the open black space between title and signature.

reference_purposes.Expression: The cover pairs white typography and the Uber wordmark with a large black field.
